description: This file defines a utility enum 'LoopbackHost' with static methods to determine whether a given hostname or IP address is a loopback or local network host. It includes methods for parsing IPv4 addresses and checking various IPv4 and IPv6 address ranges commonly associated with local or loopback addresses.

methods.name: isLoopback
methods.description: Checks if the provided hostname or IP address is a loopback address by calling 'isLoopbackHost'.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Determines if the host string corresponds to a loopback address common in IPv4 and IPv6, handling hostnames and raw IPs.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkHost
methods.description: Checks if the host is part of local networks, including loopback, link-local, or specific local domains.

methods.name: parseIPv4
methods.description: Parses a string into IPv4 address components if valid.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address falls within known local or private network ranges.
